General Purchase.subtitle: GENERAL PURCHASE
line_notes: Enter freight or other agreed charges as separate line items.
General Purchase.acceptance: This order includes the attached General PO Terms & Conditions (ALTOR-PROC-GPO-TC, Rev.01). Quote the PO number on all documents.
General Purchase.terms_intro: These conditions form part of the purchase order. ALTOR means the buyer/hirer named on the order; Supplier means the named vendor.
terms: Order acceptance
Confirm the PO in writing before supply. Special terms and approved attachments prevail over these conditions. Supplier terms apply only if ALTOR expressly accepts them in writing.
Prices & variations
Fixed rates cover the agreed scope, packing and delivery obligations, excluding applicable VAT. No substitutions, excess quantities, additional work or charges without written ALTOR approval.
Delivery & delays

Meet agreed dates and delivery terms; notify delays promptly. Provide a PO-referenced delivery note. Unless otherwise agreed, title and risk pass on delivery and acceptance. Delay damages apply only if stated in the PO.
Quality & compliance

Supply genuine, compliant, fit-for-purpose goods, new unless otherwise agreed; provide applicable certificates and safety data sheets. Services require competent personnel, applicable permits, insurance and site safety compliance.
Inspection & rejection
ALTOR may inspect before or after delivery. Receipt/payment is not final acceptance. Rectify or replace shortages, defects or rejected items at supplier cost, including collection and redelivery.
Invoice & payment

Quote the PO number; attach signed delivery note, approved receipt, service certificate or timesheet as applicable. Payment follows PO terms after valid invoice and supporting records; ALTOR may withhold disputed sums or offset documented amounts due.
Warranty & liability

Honour the agreed warranty and remedy defects at supplier cost. Each party is liable for direct losses caused by its breach or negligence, subject to law; supplier is responsible for third-party claims caused by its supply or misconduct.
Confidentiality & subcontracting
Protect ALTOR and client information; no disclosure except as legally required. No assignment or subcontracting without prior written ALTOR approval; supplier remains responsible.
Default & cancellation

ALTOR may terminate the affected balance for uncured material breach after written notice, or immediately for serious safety/legal breaches. Reasonable documented replacement costs may be recovered; pay only accepted supply and agreed unavoidable costs on convenience cancellation.
Force majeure

The affected party shall promptly notify the other in writing, provide evidence and mitigate delay. If performance is prevented for 30 days, either party may cancel the affected balance without penalty, subject to accrued obligations.
Ethics & compliance

Comply with applicable anti-bribery, sanctions, labour and trade laws; disclose conflicts of interest. No improper gifts or payments. ALTOR may suspend or terminate for serious compliance breaches. UAE law applies; unresolved disputes go to the competent courts of Abu Dhabi.
General Purchase.terms_ack: Supplier acknowledgment: acceptance of the PO includes acceptance of these conditions.

terms: Order & scope
Confirm the PO in writing. Special terms and approved attachments prevail. Supplier terms apply only if expressly accepted by ALTOR in writing; no deviations without written approval.
Specifications & condition

Supply the approved make, model, capacity, year and accessories. Assets shall be new and unused unless expressly stated otherwise. Disclose used-asset condition, operating hours, defects and service history before acceptance.
Price & delivery
Fixed prices cover agreed scope, excluding applicable VAT. Meet delivery schedule and packing/transport terms. Notify delays promptly; delay damages apply only if stated on the PO.
Inspection & acceptance

ALTOR may inspect before dispatch and at delivery. Final acceptance requires conformity, documents and agreed tests. Receipt or payment does not waive latent defects; rectify or replace rejected assets at supplier cost.
Documents & traceability
Supply serial/chassis or batch IDs, manufacturing year, applicable conformity/origin and inspection certificates, manuals, registration, service history and warranty documents.
Commissioning & training
Where included, complete installation, function/load tests and commissioning by competent personnel, with signed acceptance records and agreed operator/maintenance training.
Warranty & support

State warranty duration and start event; unless agreed otherwise, start at final acceptance. Supplier bears covered repair/replacement, labour, removal and transport costs. Rectified parts carry the agreed replacement warranty or remaining warranty, whichever is longer.
Title & risk

Supplier warrants clear title free from liens. Unless expressly agreed otherwise, title and risk pass on delivery and acceptance. Advance payments require agreed security/title arrangements where applicable.
Invoice & payment

Invoice against agreed milestones with PO reference, delivery/GRN, asset identification and acceptance evidence. ALTOR may withhold disputed sums or offset documented amounts due. Advance security/retention applies only if stated in PO.
Safety, insurance & liability
Meet applicable laws, site rules, permits and insurance requirements. Supplier is liable for direct loss and third-party claims caused by its defects, breach or negligence, subject to law.
Default & cancellation

ALTOR may reject or terminate for uncured material breach after written notice, or immediately for serious safety/legal breaches. Recover reasonable documented replacement costs; settle accepted supply and agreed unavoidable costs on convenience cancellation.
Force majeure

The affected party shall promptly notify the other in writing, provide evidence and mitigate delay. If performance is prevented for 30 days, either party may cancel the affected balance without penalty, subject to accrued obligations.
Ethics & confidentiality

No bribery, counterfeit goods or conflicts of interest; comply with applicable trade and labour laws. Protect client data; no assignment/subcontracting without written consent. UAE law applies; disputes go to competent Abu Dhabi courts.

Cross Hire.subtitle: CROSS HIRE • MATERIALS & EQUIPMENT
line_notes: Enter one-off charges on separate lines; select One-off as hire basis.
Estimated hire value only; invoices based on actual approved hire.
Cross Hire.acceptance: This order includes the attached Cross Hire PO Terms & Conditions (ALTOR-PROC-XHPO-TC, Rev.01). Quote the PO number on all documents.
Cross Hire.terms_intro: These conditions form part of the purchase order. ALTOR means the buyer/hirer named on the order; Supplier means the named vendor.
terms: Order & rates

Confirm in writing. Special terms and approved attachments prevail; supplier terms require express written ALTOR acceptance. Rates fixed for agreed scope/extensions unless revised in writing; VAT additional as applicable.
On-hire & acceptance

Hire starts per accepted quantity/unit on signed delivery or collection in serviceable condition; if commissioning is required, on signed commissioning acceptance. Rejected items and pre-acceptance time are not chargeable.
Duration & billing

Quantities/duration are indicative unless a minimum hire is expressly agreed. Bill actual accepted quantities and periods; use agreed day/week/month or hour basis and proration. Extensions and additional charges require written approval.
Off-hire & returns

For supplier collection, hire ends on effective written off-hire when items are ready for collection, subject to agreed notice/minimum hire. For ALTOR returns, hire ends on evidenced handover at agreed yard. Partial returns stop hire for those quantities.
Return verification
Record quantities, serials and condition jointly on delivery and return. Issue return acknowledgment promptly. Supplier counting delays do not extend hire where timely handover is evidenced.
Breakdown & replacement

Supplier maintains and repairs equipment and provides equivalent replacement within agreed response time. No hire for supplier-caused breakdown, unsafe condition or expired certification until restored/replaced, even during minimum hire. ALTOR-caused downtime remains chargeable.
Condition & certification

Supply compatible, safe, serviceable materials/equipment; provide current inspections, test certificates, manuals and permits as applicable. Maintain validity throughout hire; ALTOR may reject or stop unsafe items without hire liability.
Responsibilities & insurance

Allocate transport, loading, fuel, operators, installation and dismantling in PO. Supplier maintains applicable plant, personnel and liability insurance; provide evidence on request. Operators must be competent and licensed where required.
Loss & damage

ALTOR is liable for proven loss/damage attributable to its custody or misuse, excluding normal wear and pre-existing defects. Joint records, photos and agreed rates are required, net of salvage/insurance recovery. Hire on lost items stops on agreed settlement date; no double recovery.
Invoice & reconciliation

Quote PO number; attach delivery/return dockets, off-hire records, breakdown log, approved timesheets and monthly reconciliation as applicable. Pay as agreed; disputed amounts may be withheld and documented credits offset.
Deployment & liability

Supplier authorizes ALTOR to deploy items at agreed client sites, including approved sub-hire. No direct commercial dealings on this order with ALTOR's client without consent. Each party bears direct losses caused by its breach/negligence, subject to law.
Default & termination

ALTOR may suspend unsafe supply or terminate for uncured breach after notice, or immediately for serious safety/legal breach. Recover reasonable documented substitute costs; pay only accepted hire and expressly agreed charges. Off-hire rules govern termination.
Force majeure

The affected party shall promptly notify the other in writing, provide evidence and mitigate delay. If performance is prevented for 30 days, either party may cancel the affected balance without penalty, subject to accrued obligations.
Ethics & confidentiality

Comply with applicable anti-bribery, labour, trade and safety laws; disclose conflicts, protect client data and obtain consent before subcontracting. UAE law applies; unresolved disputes go to competent Abu Dhabi courts.
Cross Hire.terms_ack: Supplier acknowledgment: acceptance of the PO includes acceptance of these conditions.

terms: Acceptance & precedence

Acceptance shall be in writing or by commencing work. The signed order, agreed special conditions, scope and these terms prevail over subcontractor quotations unless expressly incorporated. Changes require authorized written approval.
Scope & performance

Execute the agreed scope with competent supervision, adequate resources and approved methods. Confirm exclusions, interfaces and deliverables before mobilization. No further subcontracting without ALTOR’s written approval.
Programme & delays

Meet agreed mobilization, milestone and completion dates. Notify ALTOR promptly of delays and mitigate their effects. Delay damages apply only at the agreed rate and cap stated in the order, subject to applicable law.
Rates & variations

Rates are fixed for the agreed scope and include allocated resources and expenses, excluding legally chargeable VAT. Extras, overtime, standby and changes require prior written approval of scope, rate and time impact.
Measurement & certification
Payment quantities shall be based on jointly verified measurements, approved timesheets or completed milestones, as applicable. Certification does not waive quality, defect or contractual rights.
Invoices & payment

Submit valid invoices quoting the order reference, supported by certified progress, timesheets or delivery records as applicable. Payment follows agreed terms; ALTOR may withhold disputed amounts and recover documented sums due, subject to law.
Advance, retention & security
Any advance, recovery schedule, retention, release milestones and performance or advance security shall be expressly agreed in writing. No deduction shall be made twice for the same liability.
Personnel & statutory obligations
The subcontractor is responsible for lawful employment, permits, wages, welfare, competent personnel and agreed PPE. Replace unqualified or unsuitable personnel promptly at its cost.
Quality, HSE & site rules

Comply with applicable law, approved specifications, method statements and site HSE rules. Provide required certificates, risk assessments and inspections; immediately report incidents. ALTOR may stop unsafe work.
Inspection & defects

ALTOR may inspect and reject nonconforming work. Rectify defects promptly at subcontractor cost during execution and the agreed defects period. If not remedied after notice, ALTOR may arrange rectification and recover reasonable documented costs.
Materials, equipment & custody
Maintain and protect assigned materials, equipment and property. Record receipt, transfer and return; report loss or damage promptly. No unauthorized removal, substitution or modification.
Insurance & liability

Maintain legally required and agreed insurance and provide evidence before mobilization. The subcontractor is responsible for documented losses and third-party claims attributable to its breach, negligence or misconduct, subject to applicable law.
Confidentiality & ethics
Protect ALTOR and client information; comply with applicable anti-bribery, labour and trade-control laws. No unauthorized direct commercial dealings relating to this order with ALTOR’s client.
Suspension & termination

ALTOR may suspend work by written notice or terminate for material default after a reasonable cure period; serious safety or unlawful conduct may require immediate action. Convenience termination requires reasonable written notice; settle accepted work and agreed unavoidable costs, less valid recoveries.
Force majeure

Notify the other party promptly of events beyond reasonable control, provide evidence and mitigate impact. Agree time or other relief in writing; either party may terminate if prevention continues beyond an agreed period or 30 days if none is stated.
Handover & final account

Submit required inspection records, as-built documents, certificates and final measurements where applicable. Reconcile advances, retention, materials and approved variations before final settlement. Surviving warranty obligations remain effective.
Law & disputes

The order is governed by applicable UAE law. Seek amicable resolution first; unresolved disputes shall be referred to the competent courts of Abu Dhabi unless another forum is expressly agreed in writing.
